metadata.measurement_scope: trained checkpoint replay in MuJoCo, not original Isaac/PhysX play recording

model.robot_finger_joints: fixed at authored grasp; no active finger closing control

metadata.timing: pre-integration qpos/qvel/ctrl/time paired with the actual mj_step solve; no extra mj_forward in live simulation

coordinate_conventions.world: right-handed, +Z up, initial robot forward +X and robot left +Y
coordinate_conventions.hands: force on cart; moment origins named explicitly; reverse both signs for reaction at same point
coordinate_conventions.contact: force and moment on geom2, expressed in contact basis; geom1 opposite at same contact point
coordinate_conventions.contact_basis: 3 rows [normal,tangent1,tangent2] in world; world_vector = basis.T @ local_vector
coordinate_conventions.constraint_multipliers: raw solver multipliers; weld last 3 are NOT Cartesian moments

limitations: Current hand grip is maintained with two welds; no sampled hand-cart point contact forces.
Two tangent basis components encode all tangent-plane directions; no extra independent spatial force dimensions.
condim=3 contact torques are inactive/zero; six array slots do not imply six active friction DOFs.
No finger pressure map or force capacity/friction-cone envelope has been measured or synthesized.
Original previous zero-action extracts and duplicated static screenshots are superseded.
metadata.action_convention: Saved high-level action is after the existing runner command clipping. No force data are clipped.
